The Government has provided a Draft Statement of Objectives (SOO) Data Exchange Platform Operations, Modernization, and Development as Attachment 1 to this AOI. Attachment 1, Draft SOO establishes the Government’s technical and performance objectives. Vendors must use it as the baseline for their proposed technical solution and draft performance-based work statement. 2.0 Problem Statements & Desired Outcomes 2.1 Problem Statement The EIDS PMO must sustain mission-essential legacy data-exchange services while modernizing those services without degrading operational availability, cybersecurity, data integrity, or interoperability with mission partners. The current environment includes legacy Data Exchange Services (DES), Clinical Health Data Repository (CHDR), and Access Control Services Data Access Layer (ACS-DAL) capabilities requiring continuous operations, monitoring, maintenance, incident response, security compliance, and interface management. At the same time, the Government must transition legacy SOAP-based data exchanges toward cloud-native, containerized, RESTful, standards-based services that support near-real-time data exchange and future AI/ML use cases. 2.2 Desired Outcomes and Technical Focus Areas

elligent Automation and Partner Enablement The Government seeks to prepare the DxP for responsible downstream AI/ML applications and to reduce the time and effort required to onboard authorized mission partners.
